C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari denied. Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion certiorari should be granted.

Mr. Justice Doug*954las took no part in the consideration or decision of this application. R. M. Jefferies, Wm. S. Youngman, Jr. and Duncan C. Lee for petitioner.
